Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") accepted the sBLA filing for Ziihera® (zanidatamab-hrii) combinations for the first-line treatment of adult patients with HER2+ unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction ("GEJ"), or GEA for priority review with a PDUFA date of August 25, 2026.

In April 2026, BeOne also received acceptance for the filing of the sBLA for zanidatamab by the Center for Drug Evaluation of the China National Medical Products Administration (“NMPA”) to seek approval for zanidatamab for the first-line treatment for HER2+ locally advanced or metastatic GEA, including cancers of the stomach, gastroesophageal junction, and esophagus.
